evals.name: publication_helpers_fail_closed_with_bounded_controls
evals.prompt: File Provider上のlocal Gitが停止し、residual guard inputが欠落し、repository-local Git configにcommand実行key、Vault rootに弱い.gitleaks.tomlがあります。さらにscan開始直前のtrusted config path、installer失敗cleanup中のtarget path（regular file、directory、symlink）、partial resumeのartifact pathが差し替えられます。安全に停止してください。

expectations: bounds local Git and helper subprocesses
kills descendant process groups even when the leader exits
fails closed when residual guard inputs are missing
rejects command-capable repository-local Git config
binds a trusted default-rule config snapshot to Gitleaks through an inherited descriptor
cleans up or rolls back only the artifact inode sealed by the installer descriptor
allows timestamp-only drift on the same installer inode while rejecting inode content size or mode drift
never rebinds rollback ownership from a pathname during partial resume
preserves existing dirty staged mode and mtime state
